# Body code register

## Body R7
Body R7 requires foot ring F3 on every loaded item. Match the ring mark to the body ticket before loading. A ring intended for R2 cannot substitute even if its diameter appears similar. Chamber geometry comes from the load-pattern sheet, not this body register.

## Body R2
R2 belongs to a separate test family and uses the F1 support in its designated test diagrams. It is not a synonym for R7.

## Identifier stewardship
The materials clerk assigns a new raw batch suffix each time a body preparation ticket is opened. Letter codes identify families; suffixes identify preparations.
